C0200.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Left Circuit
C0200.description: The ABS control module detects a fault in the inlet/outlet solenoid for the front left brake circuit. The valve is integrated in the hydraulic block; replacement is generally a workshop task.

causes.label: Internal short to ground in valve block

C0201.title: Brake Fluid Level Switch Circuit
C0201.description: The ABS or brake control module has detected a fault in the brake fluid level switch circuit. A low fluid level indicates a potential leak in the hydraulic system and disables ABS while a separate brake warning lamp is illuminated.

causes.label: Brake fluid level low (worn pads or hydraulic leak)

C0202.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor
C0202.description: The chassis or brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake pedal position sensor. Modern brake systems use this sensor for brake assist, regenerative braking and adaptive cruise control functions.

C0203.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Front Right Circuit
C0203.description: Fault in the front right ABS solenoid (mirror of C0200).

C0205.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0205.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in the stop lamp switch circuit. The brake light switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to coordinate ABS, traction control and cruise control.

causes.label: Stop lamp switch failed or misadjusted

C0206.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Left Circuit
C0206.description: Fault in the rear left ABS solenoid valve.

C0209.title: ABS Solenoid Valve Rear Right Circuit
C0209.description: Fault in the rear right ABS solenoid valve.

C0220.title: ABS Valve Block Supply Voltage
C0220.description: Supply voltage to the ABS valve block is out of range, disabling all valve control.

C0225.title: ABS Valve Relay Circuit
C0225.description: The valve relay supplying the ABS solenoids does not respond as commanded.

C0230.title: Brake Pedal Position Sensor Circuit
C0230.description: The brake pedal position sensor reports an implausible signal. Required for brake-by-wire and stability control.

C0234.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Error
C0234.description: The ABS control module has detected that one of the wheel speed sensor signals has a frequency outside the plausible range, e.g. unrealistically high pulses or signal dropouts at speed. Stability control may be limited.

causes.label: Tone ring damaged, missing teeth, or contaminated

C0235.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Signal Erratic
C0235.description: The ABS control module has detected an erratic wheel speed sensor signal — sudden jumps or dropouts compared to the other wheels. Typical causes are a damaged tone ring or a loose sensor.

causes.label: Tone ring damaged or contaminated with metal debris
Wheel speed sensor loose in housing

C0237.title: Loss of Speed Sensor Signal Front Left
C0237.description: The ABS control module has lost the wheel speed signal from the front left wheel during driving. ABS and stability control are disabled because wheel-individual speed information is required for slip detection.

C0238.title: Speed Wheel-to-Wheel Mismatch
C0238.description: The ABS control module has detected an implausible speed difference between wheels that cannot be explained by cornering. This typically points to one suspect sensor, mismatched tyre sizes or a damaged tone ring.

causes.label: Tyre sizes or wear levels do not match across axles
Tone ring missing teeth on one wheel

C0240.title: Brake Pressure Sensor
C0240.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected a fault in a brake pressure sensor. Pressure information is used by ESP and brake assist to determine driver intent and modulation pressure during regulation.

C0241.title: ABS Warning Lamp Control Circuit
C0241.description: The ABS warning lamp control circuit is shorted or open. The driver may see a permanently lit or non-functional ABS warning lamp.

C0242.title: PCM Indicated ABS Malfunction
C0242.description: The powertrain control module reports a fault that the ABS module must consider (e.g. traction control engine torque request fault).

C0244.title: PWM Brake Pressure Modulation Circuit
C0244.description: The PWM control of the brake pressure modulation valves is faulty.

C0245.title: Wheel Speed Sensor Frequency Mismatch
C0245.description: The ABS control module has detected that the frequency of one wheel speed sensor signal does not match the others under stable driving conditions. This often indicates a tone ring with extra or missing teeth or a sensor with degraded signal quality.

C0246.title: ABS/TCS Control Module Internal Performance
C0246.description: Internal plausibility check of the combined ABS/TCS control module fails.

C0250.title: Power Steering Pump Pressure
C0250.description: The power steering control module has detected an implausible pressure or load signal from the steering pump. On hydraulic systems this may indicate low fluid or a worn pump; on electric systems it may indicate excessive motor load.

causes.label: Power steering fluid low or contaminated

C0252.title: Pump Motor Ground Circuit Open
C0252.description: The pump motor ground return is open. The motor cannot run, and the system disables ABS and stability control.

causes.label: Pin pushed back out of connector body

C0258.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit
C0258.description: The brake booster vacuum sensor reports an implausible signal; brake assist functions are reduced. The vacuum sensor tells the brake control module how much vacuum is stored in the booster; with too little vacuum the assist drops, so the module uses the signal to request more vacuum (electric pump or engine intervention) or to add hydraulic brake assist. If power assist is lost, the brakes still work through the master cylinder, but a much higher pedal force is needed.
symptoms: Brake system warning lamp or message
Firmer brake pedal, longer pedal travel or higher pedal force
Driver-assistance functions such as automatic emergency braking or adaptive cruise control may be disabled

C0265.title: EBCM Relay Circuit
C0265.description: The Electronic Brake Control Module has detected a fault in its main supply relay circuit. Without proper relay supply the EBCM cannot operate the hydraulic unit and ABS as well as stability control are disabled.

causes.label: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0266.title: Active Brake Booster
C0266.description: The brake control module has detected a fault in the active (electric or vacuum-controlled) brake booster. Active boosters are used by emergency brake assist and adaptive cruise control to autonomously build brake pressure.

causes.label: Active booster motor or solenoid failed
Vacuum supply weak (vacuum pump or hose fault)

C0267.title: Brake Pump Motor Circuit
C0267.description: The ABS or brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the brake pump motor circuit. The pump is used to build brake pressure during ABS, ESP and brake-by-wire operations and a fault disables these functions.

C0268.title: Brake Pump Run Time Exceeded
C0268.description: The brake control module has detected that the brake pump has run longer than the allowed maximum time. This typically indicates the pump cannot reach target pressure due to a hydraulic leak, air in the system or a worn pump.

C0269.title: Brake Vacuum Sensor
C0269.description: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the vacuum sensor on the brake booster. Modern systems monitor booster vacuum to ensure brake assist is available, especially with stop-start engines and electric vacuum pumps.

C0273.title: Brake Booster Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0273.description: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range or implausible signal from the brake booster pressure sensor. Brake assist and electronic boost functions may be limited.

causes.label: Wiring or connector fault to sensor

C0277.title: Brake Booster Vacuum Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0277.description: The brake control module has detected an implausible signal from the booster vacuum sensor. Loss of vacuum signal can cause hard pedal and reduced power assist.

causes.label: Vacuum leak in booster or hose

C0279.title: Brake Booster Boost Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0279.description: The brake control module has detected an electrical fault in the booster boost (assist pressure) sensor circuit. Power-assist regulation may default to a backup strategy.

C0287.title: ESP Performance
C0287.description: The stability control module has detected that overall ESP performance is degraded — typically a plausibility check between yaw rate, lateral acceleration, steering angle and wheel speeds has failed. ESP is deactivated until the root cause is resolved.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0288.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Range
C0288.description: The stability control module has detected that the yaw rate sensor signal is outside the plausible range during stable driving. This typically indicates a sensor offset, an incorrect mounting or a degraded sensor element.

C0290.title: Brake Pedal Stroke Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0290.description: The brake control module has detected an out-of-range signal from the brake pedal stroke sensor. Pedal travel information is required for brake assist and electronically boosted braking.

causes.label: Sensor mounting or pedal linkage misadjusted

C0291.title: Brake Pedal Apply Sensor Circuit Malfunction
C0291.description: Electrical fault in the brake pedal apply sensor circuit. The module cannot reliably detect whether the brake pedal is pressed, which affects ABS, ESP and brake assist functions.

C0295.title: Steering Sensor Indicates Bias
C0295.description: The stability control module has detected that the steering wheel position sensor reports a non-zero angle when the vehicle is driving straight. This bias makes ESP intervene incorrectly and the system requires recalibration.
